profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, traded under the ticker TWLO. According to its own site, it provides APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI for customer engagement and identity verification. The company describes its platform as connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI, with AI agents that draw on internal knowledge and real-time data and hand conversations to humans when complexity or customer intent calls for it. It says its tools are offered on a single platform with flexible plans and pay-as-you-go pricing.

The site frames the offering as built for engagement in the agentic era, with humans and AI agents working together across channels and conversations carrying full context so customers do not repeat themselves. Twilio describes its toolkit as expanding, with building blocks for orchestrating context-rich conversations across channels for both humans and AI agents.

The company's SEC filing record lists CIK 0001447669. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed in the record.
